FIG. 04 — TITANIUM HINGE · 7-AXIS MILLED
Design Philosophy

Engineered at the hinge.

Form is decided where the frame moves. A seven-axis milled titanium hinge, hand-finished acetate, and a tolerance measured in microns — restraint made structural.

  • HingeIntegrated titanium — 7-axis milled, no visible fastener
  • MaterialBlock acetate — Italian, 8-week cured, hand-polished
  • Tolerance±0.02 mm across every articulating surface
  • EditionNumbered — each frame engraved, sequentially
